'''Roron Corobb''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the tumultuous time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
===Life as a Jedi===
[[File:Corobb-ForceBellow.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Roron Corobb using [[Force bellow|roars]] through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].]]
Discovered during his earliest days to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Roron Corobb was delivered to the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. A [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|student]] of the [[Jedi academy|Temple's academy]], Corobb was eventually taken as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] after passing his [[Initiate Trials/Legends|last academy tests]] by the master [[Mind trick/Legends|illusionist]] [[Yarael Poof/Legends|Yarael Poof]]. After years of one-on-one study with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Poof and crafting a blue-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Corobb passed the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Trials of Knighthood]] and was made a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].<ref name="db" />

===Clash against Grievous===
By the time the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] had erupted between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref> Jedi Corobb was a Master himself,<ref name="LoE" /> one of the most well regarded [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]],<ref name="db" /> and took the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Drake Lo'gaan/Legends|Drake Lo'gaan]] as his Padawan during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Taking up the mantle of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], Corobb trained Lo'gaan on the battlefield.<ref name="LoE" />

In the [[19 BBY/Legends|final year of war]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Corobb was stationed on Coruscant when [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], leader of the Separatist fleet, emerged from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in the skies of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]]. Along with Jedi [[Roth-Del Masona]], [[Foul Moudama]], and [[B'ink Utrila]], Corobb was assigned to reinforce Masters [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] and [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]] in locating and protecting the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]].<ref name="LoE" />

As the Republic war machine [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|fought]] to protect the capital planet,<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}}</ref> Corobb and his team were rushing Chancellor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] into a bunker deep in the crust of Coruscant. As Master Shaak Ti fought to defend the doors to the bunker, Grievous slipped past unnoticed and engaged the four Jedi protecting Palpatine in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]]. Grievous toyed with the Jedi for a time before [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitating]] Masona first. Corobb, who accidentally kicked Masona's head across the room during the fight, lost his focus and became distracted long enough for Grievous to kill him with a stab to the heart before finishing the remaining two defenders.<ref name="LoE" />

===Legacy===
When Corobb's Padawan was captured by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] told Lo'gaan that it was [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] who killed the Ithorian. Giving false information, he explained that Corobb had been killed by his Jedi allies so that Grievous could capture the Chancellor.<ref name="eveg">''[[Evasive Action: End Game]]''</ref>

==Powers and abilities==
Roron Corobb had a [[Force bellow|guttural roar]] that was described as being "as powerful as any Force blast," and was projected from his dual mouths on the sides of his neck. His skill with a lightsaber was such that he was one of six Jedi hand-picked to safeguard the Chancellor. Known as a swordsman of legendary degree, Corobb was a highly skilled practitioner of Form V, Djem So, often utilizing the reverse-grip. His immense skill allowed him to survive much of the battle, though he was ultimately no match for General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="LoE" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:RoronCorobbDeath-CW25.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Roron is struck down by [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] in the animated cartoon.]]
Corobb and [[Foul Moudama]] were two Jedi in the [[Cartoon Network]] poll to introduce a new Jedi to the series of a species from the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] scene in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']], which [[Voolvif Monn]] won. However, the runner-ups were both introduced later anyway.

There is a discrepancy in the events surrounding Roron Corobb that are portrayed in the ''Clone Wars'' microseries when compared to ''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''.<ref name=":0">{{CW|25}}</ref><ref name="LoE" /> In the cartoon, Corobb and Moudama are shown on a long chase trying to save Palpatine from Grievous,<ref name=":0" /> and are with Shaak Ti from the start.<ref name="CW23" /> In the book, however, they join in on protecting Palpatine at a much later point, and are killed very quickly along with two other Jedi.<ref name="LoE" />

The name "Roron Corobb" is derived from [[Ron Cobb]], the name of the concept artist who designed the Ithorian species for the cantina scene in ''A New Hope''.

A Roron Corobb action figure was released in late summer of 2007 as part of [[Hasbro]]'s ''[[Star Wars]]'' 30th Anniversary Collection.
